`{@debug}` logs values and pauses in the debugger while the developer tools are open. It is for a debugging session, not for code that ships.

The rule suggests removing the tag.

{/* Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit this section. */}

## Configure

Off by default. It runs on the Svelte components that an ESLint config lints with `svelte-eslint-parser`, in the place of the rule of `eslint-plugin-svelte`:

{/* skip */}

```js eslint.config.js
import svelte from "eslint-plugin-svelte";

export default [
  ...svelte.configs.recommended,
  { rules: { "svelte/no-at-debug-tags": "error" } },
];
```

{/* End of the generated section. */}

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad */}

```svelte
{@debug user}
<h1>Hello {user.name}!</h1>
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}

```svelte
<h1>Hello {user.name}!</h1>
```
